policy: flag only; nothing deleted. The tokenisation step must drop these doc_sha256 values.
limitations: Character 64-grams detect verbatim or near-verbatim overlap only; paraphrased or translated benchmark items are NOT detected.
Corpus scanned at stride 8 and capped at 40,000 characters per document.
MinHash with 32 permutations and 8x4 banding is tuned for recall of high-similarity pairs; moderately similar documents will be missed.
LSH keeps the FIRST document seen in each bucket, so which member of a near-duplicate cluster survives depends on file order.
